title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.67 (quiet) at 22:00 UTC on 7 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 7 日 22:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.67（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.67 (1M) at 22:00 UTC on 7 October 2026. The 22 hour is complete (60 samples through 22:59; hour-start 0.67/1M, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 2.33 (first at 2026-10-07T20:57:00Z; label 2P). Published-window maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-10-07T17:59:00Z; label 3M). Window starts 2026-10-07T17:59:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 2.67. The 23 UTC hour is incomplete (57 samples through 23:56).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
